info.name: SkillSwap API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the SkillSwap Backend REST API.
Covers the complete user journey, authentication, profile management, skill catalog & user declarations, weekly availability, match recommendations, swap requests, SignalR/REST chat, session scheduling & escrow lifecycle, wallet balances & transactions, subscriptions, reviews, notifications, platform moderation, and administrative operations.

request.description: ASP.NET Core health check middleware probe.
Returns status, UTC timestamp, and API version.
Registers a new user, automatically creating their profile, wallet (0 balance), and default Free subscription.
Registers a new learner user.
Logs in and retrieves a JWT access token for the teacher.
Logs in and retrieves a JWT access token for the learner.
Logs in an administrator (configured via AdminUser:Email and AdminUser:Password) to retrieve an admin JWT token.

Removes a declared skill from the user's profile.
Replaces the weekly recurring availability schedule for the teacher.

Retrieves paginated chat history for the conversation.

Retrieves session details and status.

Lists chronological ledger transactions (AvailableDelta, HeldDelta, Description, CreatedAtUtc). Idempotency keys are kept internal and not exposed in public DTOs.

Admin endpoint: grants initial or promotional learning minutes to a user's wallet with guaranteed idempotency via Idempotency-Key header. Replays return the existing transaction without double-crediting. Payloads with conflicting keys return 409 Conflict.
Admin endpoint: creates a new catalog category.
Admin endpoint: creates a new catalog skill under a category.
Admin endpoint: resolves a disputed session, releasing escrow to teacher or refunding held minutes back to learner.
Admin endpoint: lists submitted moderation reports.
Admin endpoint: updates the resolution status of a report (Status: 0 = Pending, 1 = UnderReview, 2 = Resolved, 3 = Dismissed).
